method.scope: Review of numerical model-comparison claims and statements about performed analyses, using the evidence available to each submitting model.
method.reviewer: AI assistants with prior project context; not an independent human or blinded evaluation.
method.numeric_gap_rule: A positive selected-minus-minimum CV gap alone is not an error. A simpler candidate can be selected with an explicit, accurate tradeoff.
limitations: The review identifies specific checkable contradictions; supported is not a comprehensive correctness grade.
Qualitative statistical uncertainty, stopping judgments and working notes are not exhaustively exported or graded.
Independent replication, calibrated significance, causality and all possible interpretations were not established by this review.
No valid submission receives no_submission; protocol or API failures are not graded as false numerical explanations.
method.compact_evidence: The selected and minimum-exposed cards are retained here. Other visible cards, exact prompts, responses and tool results remain in the archived raw records.
